==Description==
'''Backrooms''' was a reocurring Easter egg found in the [[Main Lobby]]. It was a room hidden out of bounds of the map, which was either accessed through a hidden spot or by going out of bounds with bugs.

==Appearance==
{{Tabber
|Version 3
|'''Backrooms''' were a liminal building with a yellow fabric floor, yellow walls and a grey ceiling. There was nothing inside the building other than a few lamps, a sticker and an exit made out of blue blocks.

It was accessed through two ways, the simplest being the intended way which was by walking into the wall behind the whiteboard in the chill area of the [[Main Lobby]]. The alternate method was to clip out of bounds the [[Main Lobby]] and attempt to launch with the use of bugs to the '''Backrooms''', which while in theory technically possible to achieve is so difficult it was not worth the effort.

This location can be left by either resetting your character or going to the blue door.
|Version 2
|'''Backrooms''' were a liminal building with a yellow fabric floor, yellow walls and a grey ceiling. There was nothing inside the building other than a few lamps, a sticker and an exit made out of blue blocks.

It was accessed through two ways, the simplest being the intended way which is by entering one of the doors of extra room in the [[Main Lobby]]. Only one works, which was at the furthest point of the room in the right hole. The alternate method was to clip out of bounds in the extra room and if proper spot was chosen, the player would fall inside the '''Backrooms'''.

This location can be left by either resetting your character or going to the blue door.
|Version 1
|'''Backrooms''' were a liminal building with a yellow fabric floor, yellow walls and a grey ceiling. There was nothing inside the building other than a few lamps.

It could be accessed by clipping out of bounds in the [[Main Lobby]] in specific spots.

This location can be left by either resetting your character.
}}

==Trivia==
*'''Backrooms''' are a reference to [[wp:The Backrooms|The Backrooms]], a fictional location first invented on [[wp:4chan|4chan]] which is accessed by going out of bounds.
*Both the 2022 and 2026 versions of the '''Backrooms''' use the same model, though with minor changes.
**The 2022 version uses old Roblox materials. The one introduced in 2026 uses 2022 materials, which changed the look of the floor.
**A proper entrance and exit was added to it.
**The [[32]] sticker can be found on one of the walls in the current version.
*The exit being marked with blue tape is a reference to the ''Backrooms'' movie.
*The roof of the '''Backrooms''' is not solid, which is why falling into them allows the player to get into it. This also means that, with emotes that boost jump height, it is possible to jump on top of the walls of the '''Backrooms'''.
**The easiest emote to do this with is the [[Bunny Mech]] emote.
